internal.modified: rank at most six before bfloat16 write, native option head frozen; additive map fitted from the final feed-forward input and the pre-normalization residual. Rounding can increase numerical rank.

input_modes.alone: one complete target sentence inside publisher seven-choice prompt
input_modes.local: one previous and one following sentence from same judgment around an explicitly marked target
input_modes.packed-ordered: shared fixed option list, at most eight consecutive sentences, one answer cue per sentence; original means unchanged weights under this new prompt.
input_modes.packed-rotated: matched sentence-token blocks, cyclically rotated, evaluated with the ordered weights
input_modes.packed-alone: matched packed-format singleton, fitted using the same 357 rows

official_test: Untouched in this lane. All validation results use the validation CSV and the listed 16 judgment IDs.
evaluation_metric: pooled seven-class macro-F1 including zero for class with no support and no predictions; transfer to full benchmark is unverified.
